thread:
ada: Heads up — saw a puzzling DX bug when people import our SDK in an edge sample app. Overloads that use generics + chained helpers collapse to `any` after minification. Anyone else hit this?

ada: Repro in the sample app:
```ts
// sdk/src/chain.ts
export function mapItems<T, R>(items: T[], fn: (t: T)=>R): R[]
export function mapItems(items: any[], fn: any){ return items.map(fn) }

// app/edge/worker.ts
import sdk from 'redwood-sdk' // note default import used by sample
const out = sdk.mapItems(["a","b"], s => s.length) // used to be number[] but is any[]
```

ron: interesting — sample uses default export, our package ship has both `exports` + a `default` re-export wrapper. Some bundlers will elide named re-exports and that can break declaration linking.

maya: Are you shipping `types` only at root or also via `exports` maps? TS 5.x will prefer `exports.types` if present otherwise the consumer resolver can follow runtime path which might be a small wrapper file without full declarations.

ada: package.json: 
```json
{"main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs","types":"dist/index.d.ts","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}}
```

ron: aha — missing `exports.".".types`. Add it. Also ensure `dist/index.mjs` doesn't re-export from a `.cjs` helper that lacks typings. If you have a thin ESM runtime shim like `export { default } from './cjs-shim.js'` TS may not pick up the original declarations.

maya: Another vector: esbuild/terser minify can mangle parameter names in the `.d.ts` generation step if you generate d.ts from compiled code with tools that rely on source names. We don't do that normally but double-check the d.ts pipeline.

ada: quick test: swapped sample to `import { mapItems } from 'redwood-sdk'` (named import) and inference came back. So this is definitely import-shape-related.

ron: short-term fixes:
- Add `"exports": { ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" } }`
- Avoid default-export wrapper that re-exports into a different file; prefer a single ESM entry with correct re-exports in the same module that has types.
- Add unit tests that run `tsc --noEmit` on the sample apps using `node` and `bundler` moduleResolution.

maya: long-term: update our packaging pipeline to emit a small `types`-only index next to runtime ESM shims so TS always resolves to the canonical d.ts file. Also add a cookbook note in onboarding for samples: "prefer named imports in edge samples until package `exports` includes `types` map".

ada: filed INF-8531 with repro repo + minimal esbuild bundle. (linked)

build-bot: CI: created branch "fix/exports-types-map" and ran tsc against samples on 5.0/5.1/5.2 — failures reproduced on 5.1 only.

doc-bot: Suggested doc: "Packaging and TS: exports/types patterns for ESM + Edge" created in docs queue.

ron: Follow-up: we should also add a short lint rule in the SDK repo to warn if `exports` lacks types mapping when `types` exists at root. Saves a lot of confusion.

maya: I'll draft the lint rule + the cookbook blurb. ada: thanks for the clear repro — will review your PR.
